Testing / Admin

Temporary page for site testing and administration. No login is required yet.

TSIP re-run compare

Re-runs the most recent completed TSIP archive job (web.tsip_run) via TpRunTsip, then compares database archive data and report files (baseline vs new). Same-origin start + poll (no CORS).

Report files for this test are written to a dedicated folder (not the original user’s TSIP work dir):

D:\inetpub\fcsa\admin\tsip-runs\{prefix}_{parm}_{run}\

Each run creates its own subfolder (including compare-summary.txt). Compare JSON status files stay under D:\inetpub\fcsa\admin\jobs\. Archive rows remain in the database (web.tsip_run) keyed by a new run_id.

The result JSON includes db_summary, files_summary, and an overall summary (case counts, calc fingerprints, report-line text, and on-disk file diffs). Timestamp-only lines are treated as volatile.
